stories.title: Bitcoin slips toward $58,500 as a tariff report and chip sell-off hit US stock futures; bitcoin funds lose money a sixth day
stories.summary: Reuters reported that the US is about to announce new tariffs on 16 trading partners, and chipmakers led pre-market declines before the US open. Bitcoin fell too, while US spot bitcoin funds had their sixth straight day of outflows.
points: Bitcoin slipped to about $58,500 at 7:01am ET Wednesday, per CoinDesk; Decrypt had it at $58,801, down 1.7% over 24 hours.
Nasdaq 100 futures were down 625.75 points, or 2.38%, at 6:01am ET, per Reuters via Investing.com, with Nvidia down 5.1% before the open.
US spot bitcoin funds lost $231.4 million on Tuesday 24 Nov, their sixth straight day of outflows, per Farside data reported by CoinDesk. BlackRock's IBIT accounted for $175.3 million.
That takes November's outflows to $4.94 billion, the funds' worst month, ahead of June 2026's $4.51 billion, per Decrypt.
The new tariffs would partly replace ones struck down by the US Supreme Court in February, per Reuters via RTE. The White House has not yet given the rates.

stories.title: US inflation report due today, two weeks before the Fed's next rate decision
stories.summary: October's PCE inflation report, the Fed's preferred inflation measure, comes out at 8:30am ET today (20:30 Bangkok) together with the second estimate of third-quarter growth. Markets already expect the Fed to raise rates in December.
points: Annual PCE inflation is expected to climb from 3.6% in September to 3.8% in October, per ABC News via Yahoo Finance.
Forecasts for core inflation over the year cluster around 3.2-3.3%: Cleveland Fed nowcast 3.21%, Goldman Sachs 3.24%, Pantheon 3.3%, per Admiral Markets (18 Nov).
CME FedWatch shows a 97% chance of a December hike and 63% of another in January, per Reuters via Investing.com.
Q3 growth is expected at 3.5% (first estimate 3.4%) and durable goods orders at +0.7% (September +1.9%), per XTB.
The Fed's Beige Book follows at 2:00pm ET, and US markets are closed tomorrow for Thanksgiving.

stories.title: US prosecutors move to seize USDC in wallets hijacked in the Binance hack
stories.summary: US prosecutors have filed a complaint to take over USDC stablecoins they link to North Korea's Lazarus Group, which robbed Binance of about $6 billion on 29 October.
points: The complaint was filed on 23 Nov and says the hackers took control of 32 Binance wallet addresses on 29 Oct, per Protos.
The 32 blocklisted wallets hold nearly $342 million of USDC, per Protos.
Circle, which issues USDC, agreed to keep the wallets blocked and mint replacement USDC if the coins are forfeited, per Protos.
Hackers posing as job recruiters got a Binance employee to run malware, per Protos.

briefs.title: Utah moves to drop criminal charges against Kalshi
briefs.summary: Utah's attorney general moved to dismiss the charges against Kalshi and its founders without prejudice after the prediction market blocked Utah users, per PYMNTS.

briefs.title: Hyperliquid's HYPE is the worst top-20 coin today
briefs.summary: HYPE fell 8.2% to $57.86 after trading firm Abraxas Capital closed its Hyperliquid positions, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Japan's SBI and SMFG start a Solana joint venture
briefs.summary: SBI, SMFG and the Solana Foundation launched SBI Solana Global to work on stablecoin payments and tokenization, per The Block.

briefs.title: Hong Kong launches a platform for tokenized bonds
briefs.summary: The HKMA's CMU Digital Asset Platform offers round-the-clock settlement, with HSBC, Standard Chartered, Bank of China (HK) and DBS among the first users, per The Block.

briefs.title: Tether reportedly asked hack victims for fees to return frozen USDT
briefs.summary: Bloomberg reported Tether sought fees of up to 20% before reissuing frozen USDT to some hack victims; Tether says the fees cover its process and legal costs, per Startup Fortune.

briefs.title: South Korea moves to end its 2017 ban on new token sales
briefs.summary: The regulator's draft law would let issuers file white papers, cap exchange owners at 20% and limit won stablecoins to bank-led groups; parliament must still approve it, per Coinpaprika.

Expected 650,000 (prior 676,000), per XTB; Continuum Economics forecasts 635,000.

calendar.event: MSCI removes Strategy (MSTR) from its indexes
calendar.note: Strategy leaves MSCI USA, World and ACWI after the 30 Nov close, per KuCoin. JPMorgan analysts estimated about $2.8 billion of selling by index funds, per Bitcoin Magazine.
September job openings were 7.5 million, per the BLS, which sets the 10:00am ET release.
Date and time per the BLS schedule. October payrolls rose 165,000 with unemployment at 4.1%, per LiteFinance.

calendar.note: Decision on Wed 9 Dec, per the Federal Reserve's meeting calendar. Fed officials stop public comments from Sat 28 Nov. CME FedWatch showed a 97% chance of a hike, per Reuters via Investing.com (25 Nov).
